newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products steady to easier, business slow.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products steady to easier, business slow.

text.p: NWE oil products were broadly unchanged in thin trading on Tuesday.
Gas oil shed 50 cents. Germand and French demand supported heating oil cargo premiums around Jan +$5.50/6.50. Barge demand was flat.
Naphtha trade continued dull with end-users mostly covered to the year-end and staying out of the market.
Gasoline held firm with U.S. markets supported by a cat cracker outage at Exxon's Baton Rouge refinery. However, high freight costs continued to hamper transatlantic arbitrage trade.
Fuel oil was steady. Cargo activity was quiet, but barges were busier on good demand.
